title: direction
description: The record of ONE researcher decision: what it decided, why, and what it expects to happen. Island changes that carry the decision out (island.created / island.updated) are separate events whose `cause` is this direction's id. Several directions can be live at once. Code, not the model, later marks each prediction met / missed / open from events; that is the decision log. Subject is bench:<name>.

brief.description: The decision in prose, addressed to the lab assistants. Specific and falsifiable: name the change, why it should help, and when it nets out. Example: 'Shrink the table to 2^10 and add one Newton step; this only pays if the refinement stays under ~400 Toffolis.'

why.description: The evidence the decision rests on, citing what was observed (island trends, attempt counts, failures). Lets a later reader judge whether the reasoning held.

prediction.description: A checkable expectation. Example: {metric: 'island:3/best_cost', threshold: 125000, by_attempts: 300} means island 3's best cost should drop below 125,000 within 300 attempts made after this direction.

threshold.description: Value the metric must reach (below, for costs).

by_attempts.description: Attempts after this direction within which it must happen.

islands.description: Islands this decision concerns, if any.
